confident_case.query: What is the minimum fire resistance rating required for walls separating a boiler room from other parts of a building?
confident_case.answer: Under Clause 6.1.1.2 of the National Building Code of India [1], walls separating a boiler room or central heating equipment from other parts of a building must provide a minimum fire resistance rating of 120 minutes (2 hours). All connecting door openings must be protected by self-closing fire doors having an equivalent 120-minute rating [Volume 1, PDF p. 314-315].
